newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies 15 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies 15 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 15 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Pine Bluff School District #3, Ariz., $4.5 million of refunding and construction bonds. GO school bonds.
--Ventura Community SD, Iowa, $1.950 million school general obligation bonds.
--Rich Township High School District, Ill., $14 million of GO and refunding bonds and $3.05 million of bonds.
--Hartland District, Mich., $19 million of school district bonds.
--Hibbing, Minn., $5.3 million of GO public utility revenue refunding bonds.
--South St. Paul, Minn., $5 million of GO tax increment bonds.
--Greenville Area School District, Pa., $8 million of GO bonds under the alternate bidding program.
--West Perry School District, Pa., $6 million of GO bonds.
--Mesquite, Texas, $5.140 million and $1.46 million of GOs.
--West Harris MUD No. 10, Texas, $3.970 million GOs.
--Phillips School District, Wis., $2.6 million school building bonds.
